articles.title: Grayscale's Pandl says Strategy should sell $3B Bitcoin to restore confidence
articles.snippet: Grayscale's research head Zach Pandl said Strategy should sell $3 billion in Bitcoin to cover its cash obligations, but CryptoQuant argued the company has other ways to support STRC.
